subject: Pipeline -> pool alignment & burst strategy
body:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline -> pool alignment & burst strategy

Team,

Quick weekly check — want to lock a pragmatic mapping of Q2 pipeline to dedicated pools so Sales, Infra and Finance are aligned on what we need to reserve vs. plan to burst. High level: DataScale (DS-2026-042) is asking for a pilot start in May with a potential committed pool, and we have 2 other near-term deals that could push Q2 utilization over our current reserved runway.

Ask: please review the attached pool_matchback_q2.xlsx and reply with the smallest set of reserved allocations we can commit to today (by pool type: A100/40GB, H100/80GB, mixed), plus a recommended burst cushion (in % of peak) we can offer as pay-as-you-go. Specifics I need by Wed EOD 24 Mar:
- Infra: minimum commit per pool (gpus, vCPU host type, region) + expected lead time for additional reserved slots
- Sales: prioritized deal list with start dates, estimated qps/tokens/sec, and preferred model family (75% H100 vs A100?)
- Finance: provisional cost delta if we convert X burst hours into reserved slots (use the numbers in the sheet)

Notes:
- We should avoid over-committing to A100 when customers show model preferences for H100 (performance/cost trade).
- Default safety buffer proposal: 20% of forecasted peak unless Infra pushes back.

Attachments: pool_matchback_q2.xlsx (sheet: summary, per-deal rows)

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

---

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline -> pool alignment & burst strategy

Thanks — quick infra reality check below.

Short answer: we can meet the pilot with a mix of reserved + burst but need clearer per-deal QPS/token expectations. Current constraints:
- Reserved inventory (US-west): 120 H100 slots, 80 A100 slots.
- Committed pools already spoken for (existing contracts): ~30 H100 and 15 A100 through June.
- Median lead time to spin new reserved nodes (contracting + infra): 4–6 weeks.

Recommendations:
1) For DataScale pilot (May): reserve 8 H100 and 6 A100 as pilot mix; allow burst up to 2x for first 2 weeks to absorb onboarding spikes.
2) For near-term enterprise deals (listed in sheet): prioritize H100 if their evals show >1.2x perf gain. If not, use A100 to save cost.
3) Safety buffer: reduce Sergio's default 20% to 15% for pooled reserved capacity if Finance requires hard cap; otherwise keep 20% for volatile onboarding traffic.

Action items for infra:
- We'll tag 10 H100 slots as "pilot-reserve/datascale" pending contract sign (can hold for 2 weeks).
- If Sales confirms later this week, infra will convert tags to reserved by 29 Mar (requires PO + finance signoff).

Logan
Infrastructure Capacity Lead
logan.wright@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, John Davis <john.davis@datascale.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline -> pool alignment & burst strategy

Sergio / Team — added Sales context and deal prioritization.

Headline: DataScale is top priority for May pilot; they requested dedicated latency SLAs for the pilot and have signaled a conservative initial commit. Other wins (names redacted) could close in late May / June and would add ~14 H100-equivalent slots combined.

Per-deal brief (from our CRM and latest AE notes):
- DataScale (DS-2026-042): pilot start May 10; initial commit estimate 8 H100-equivalent GPUs; preferred model family: h100-optimized. PO expected by 29 Mar.
- Nimbus Analytics (NIM-310): likely close end-May; estimate 6 H100-equivalent.
- Helio Systems (HEL-77): evaluating; low confidence but could add 8 A100-equivalent.

Sales asks:
- Please hold 10 H100 slots for DataScale pilot until 29 Mar (Logan suggested tagging 10; Sales will provide PO if legal/finance agree).
- If Finance cannot underwrite holdback, propose explicit burst credits for pilot week (2x baseline) and a fast path to convert to reserved on PO receipt.

Attachment: datascale_mop_draft.pdf — the pilot MOP with proposed SLA language and tentative schedule (internal copy).

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

---

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, John Davis <john.davis@datascale.com>
Cc: purchasing@datascale.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline -> pool alignment & burst strategy — action items

All,

Consolidating actions from this thread and the attached sheet. Please review and ack by Thursday EOD (1 Apr). If you can't meet the timeline, call it out and propose when.

Summary table (high level):
- DataScale (DS-2026-042): hold 10 H100 (tag), reserve 8 H100 on PO; pilot start May 10; Sales to deliver PO by 29 Mar.
- Nimbus Analytics: monitor; if sign by 15 Apr, convert 6 H100 to reserved.
- Helio Systems: low confidence; do not reserve until firm commit.

Action items:
1) Laura: confirm PO delivery timeline and send final MOP to procurement/finance (due 29 Mar) — DONE/IN PROGRESS?
2) Logan: tag 10 H100 slots as pilot-reserve/datascale and prepare conversion checklist (deadline: 29 Mar).
3) Monica / Priyom (Finance): run quick cost delta for reserving 8 H100 vs burst for first 90 days and confirm if we can underwrite a 2-week hold without committed revenue.
4) Sergio: schedule a 30-min triage call Fri 2 Apr if PO not in hand by EOD 29 Mar.

If DataScale sends PO to purchasing@datascale.com (copied), we will prioritize conversion. John — please confirm your purchasing timeline.

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced above: pool_matchback_q2.xlsx, datascale_mop_draft.pdf
